question: Which of the following deserts is visible in the southern part of the world map?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalahari Desert**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kalahari Desert** is located in the **southern part** of the world map, covering parts of countries like **Botswana, Namibia, and South Africa**.
 
• It is a **semi-arid sandy savannah**, spanning approximately **900,000 square kilometers**.
 
• The desert is unique due to its ability to support a diverse ecosystem, including the presence of some vegetation like grasses and shrubs. *Hence, the statement is correct.*
 
• The **Kalahari Desert** is known for being home to indigenous communities such as the **San Bushmen**, who have adapted to living in this challenging environment.
 
• It is characterized by **high temperatures**, low rainfall, and extensive sand dunes. *Hence, this fits the southern world map desert context.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Other deserts mentioned:**

 
 
• **Gobi Desert:** Located in **Asia**, spanning parts of **Mongolia and China**. It lies in the **northern hemisphere**, making it unsuitable as the correct answer.
 
• **Thar Desert:** Found in **India and Pakistan**. It is located in the **northern hemisphere** and is known for being the **largest desert in India.**
 
• **Sonoran Desert:** Situated in **North America**, covering parts of **Mexico, Arizona, and California**. It is in the **northern hemisphere** as well.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of the Kalahari Desert:**
 
 
• The desert supports unique wildlife such as **meerkats, gemsboks, and hyenas**.
 
• It is home to **Okavango Delta**, one of the largest inland deltas, providing water to parts of the desert.
 
• The soil in the Kalahari is rich in **iron oxide**, giving it a red-orange color.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Climate:** The Kalahari Desert experiences a **semi-arid climate**, with **rainfall ranging** from 5 to 10 inches per year.
 
• **Indigenous Communities:** The **San Bushmen** are among the oldest known inhabitants of the region, relying on **hunting and gathering** for survival.
 
• **Geographical Spread:** The desert covers regions in **southern Africa**, making it easily identifiable in the southern part of the world map.
